verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a curated llms.txt at https://www.pulumi.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Pulumi summary), and a second llms.txt exists under /dev/. Pulumi also documents Agent Skills, knowledge packages that teach AI coding assistants Pulumi workflows, which counts as agent-oriented documentation. missing for 10: markdown renderings of doc pages (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), evidence of an llms-full.txt or the llms.txt's coverage depth, and independent hands-on reports of agents using these docs.
